title: 8.962 General Relativity
authors: Scott A. Hughes (instructor; author of the Lecture Guide)
description: MIT's graduate course in general relativity: the geometric viewpoint and tensors on Minkowski spacetime, stress-energy and conservation laws, the equivalence principle, covariant derivative and parallel transport, Lie derivatives and Killing vectors, geodesics, curvature, the Einstein field equation (two derivations), linearised gravity, gravitational radiation, cosmology, spherical compact sources, black holes. 23 recorded lectures with transcripts, a 20-page Lecture Guide, per-lecture summaries and problem sets.
rightsNotes: Content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by MIT OpenCourseWare (licence link in the page footer). Corniversity is private and non-commercial.

The required textbook (Carroll, Spacetime and Geometry, Cambridge University Press 2019) and the additional texts are commercial; Corniversity does not require them and uses Carroll's free 1997 lecture notes as a supplement instead.

Prof. Hughes's handwritten and typed notes are hosted on a personal MIT page (web.mit.edu/sahughes/www/8.962/) that states no licence; they are linked from OCW's Lecture Summaries page but are not recorded as a Corniversity source.
Convention: the Lecture Guide writes metrics with signature (−,+,+,+), e.g. ds² = −(1 + 2Φ)dt² + (1 − 2Φ)(dx² + dy² + dz²), and uses G = c = 1 except where it restores 8πG/c⁴.
